title: Mutate in Place
goal: Declare the method receiver and caller binding to allow mutation.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Methods and Traits

hints: A caller binding must permit mutable borrows.
explanation: &mut self borrows the struct mutably so its fields can be updated. The variable holding the struct must also be declared with let mut, or calling a mutable method fails with error E0596. Shared references &self cannot mutate fields, causing error E0594. Taking mut self moves ownership into the function and consumes the struct, making subsequent reads in main fail with error E0382.
